images.observations: Front/rear/three-quarter preserve the slender continuous spine, sparse crossbars and top red beacon. Rear structural faces are notably dark under the directional studio rig.
Tapered mounting shoe, anchors, terminal, restrained rear conduit/clip, clamped aerial and red faceted obstruction lamp are readable. No dense radar or greeble silhouette.

All twelve endpoint/strobe/rig panels show the same true-scale shipped player and thin antenna. Classic hardware remains deliberately small; h13 taller than h7. Bright pale deck is a labeled proxy, not source surface calibration.

limits: Offline CPU software EEVEE, not live game, GPU or FPS capture.
Dusk key/rim color and intensity approximations; hemisphere, PMREM, fog, tone mapping, bloom and screen-space lighting are NOT source-equivalent.
Deck/channel/edge markers are labeled test doubles, not source fortress geometry.
Common world cameras are exact no-boost source rig formulas at 3:2; Classic halfHeight40; player actual shipped GLB at original scale.
h7 and h13 are forced-height endpoint fixtures, with explicit widths/spacing, not claimed random source draws.
GLB is reference seed42 static preview only; source hue/gain/rate/phase are rebuilt through aAnim in the runtime recipe.
